spec.title: Setup: build Log4j core at both #1173 revisions and run PatternProcessorTest (third try: Maven on JDK 8 as upstream CI)
spec.description: Setup for extension case G of llm-dlc/loops/organic-java-pr-capability-composition-fast-follow.md, no claims. In the setup worktrees under ~/.cache/in-the-loop/organic-composition-ff/worktrees (G-logging-log4j2-fix = 7107cd65, G-logging-log4j2-parent = e325de9a, the two-commit change), builds log4j-api-java9, log4j-core-java9 and log4j-core-test with -am (the first try named only log4j-core-test, and -am does not pull in the java9 modules whose zips log4j-api unpacks) with the upstream wrapper's Maven 3.8.4 (verified, in the cache's tools/) running on JDK 8 (1.8.0_512) as upstream CI does (the second try ran Maven on JDK 11, and log4j-api-test then failed to compile against sun.reflect.Reflection), with the upstream toolchains layout (JDK 8 and 11, the cache's toolchains.xml), into the cache's own m2 (first step online, the rest offline). Runs each side's PatternProcessorTest, then the landed file transplanted onto the parent, where it is expected to fail, then the landed test offline on the fix. log4j-api and log4j-core jars to .../artifacts with sha256, JUnit summaries to .../logs, build trees removed. Results go into llm-dlc/loops/organic-java-pr-capability-composition-fast-follow-setup.md.
spec.expected: every step exits 0: PatternProcessorTest passes on both sides' own trees; the transplanted landed test fails on the parent; the offline rerun passes
